content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 states that this service is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable; the case provides no coding error or evidence supporting separate payment. Prior authorization is not required, and neither a medical-necessity appeal nor peer-to-peer review has a supported basis to overturn this bundling determination. The contractual denial cannot be transferred to the patient merely because a deductible remains, so the balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
